verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission launch is on April 1, 2026, at 6:35 p.m. ET.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R9: 'lifted off from Kennedy Space Center in Florida at 6:35 p.m. ET.'; R10: 'At 5:35 p.m. CT... the Artemis II rocket sent four brave souls...' (5:35 CT = 6:35 ET)
verifications.reasoning: Post-launch recaps in R9 and R10 confirm actual liftoff at 6:35 p.m. ET on April 1, 2026, directly matching the claim.
